name: Lycos
source:
Lycos yearns to escape the centuries-long confines of his castle and reclaim his freedom. The painful memory of betrayal by his former lover keeps him on high alert, rendering him cautious of any romantic entanglements.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747560/Spellbound_Hearts/]Steam[/url]]
